Name: Vine-Covered Wooden Fence (With or Without Flowers)
Author: poopmissaccio
Description:
I love the look of nature taking over man-made things, so I decided to take the base wooden "Fence1" and cover it in vines. 

There are currently two versions of this mod; with and without small white flowers on the vines.

Will definitely be adding more flower colors in the future~ Please feel free to make suggestions for improvement or suggestions for recolors, etc. This is my very first mod.

This fence replaces Fence1 in the LooseSprites folder. It is purely an xnb mod, no Content Patcher version yet.

**Updated on January 15th, 2020. Added 3 new flower varieties. **
